author_reading.rationale: A single destination flop is the only capture stage for an asynchronous single-bit register crossing. The input is timed to clk_a; both clocks are declared asynchronous.

rationale: A clk_a-launched bit feeds a single clk_b register directly exposed as the output. No second containment stage exists. A level-versus-event contract could add delivery obligations but does not remove the missing metastability containment stage.
